raid_ap_contribution.note: Warriors have no Expose-Weakness-style analytical raid-AP model - Sunder Armor is an enemy-side debuff a solo sim already benefits from directly (see CLAUDE.md's Stage 6 finding). This flag isn't actually read by run_upgrade_sweep.py today (confirmed - it always computes the raid-AP column regardless), but it degrades correctly anyway since expose_weakness.measured_ew_uptime() looks for Expose Weakness's real spell id and finds nothing for a Warrior sim.

apl_note: Unlike Hunter's hand-embedded TypeSimple rotation, Arms Warrior uses the sim's real TypeAPL system - confirmed against proto/apl.proto that player.rotation is one shared APLRotation message across every class (type/simple/prepullActions/priorityList/groups/valueVariables all at the same top level), so arms.apl.json's raw file content is already a complete, valid player.rotation value verbatim - no transform needed.
